name: 2-Methyltetrahydrofuran
about: Measured values each record of this component was fitted to (validation/python/measured_components.py). test/properties.test.js checks that the coefficients in src/data/components.json reproduce them within the maximum deviation stated in each record.

source.name: Measured densities of the liquid at 0.1 MPa (NIST TRC ThermoML Archive)

Clapeyron equation with the vapour-pressure record (measured values of the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive and the NIST Chemistry WebBook) and the Peng-Robinson equation of state of the open-source thermo library; and measured values (NIST Chemistry WebBook)
source.fit: 25 Clapeyron values and 0 measured values, 279.00-414.71 K, max deviation 0.84 %

source.name: measured vapour pressures and the critical point
source.fit: 47 measured values (46 from the ThermoML Archive) and the critical point, 279.00-537.00 K, max deviation 0.93 %. Between 508.21 K and the critical point the curve is held only by the critical point. All the measured sets fitted together, each article with the same weight (no set preferred for a smaller stated uncertainty); mean deviation of the fit from each set: Lepori 2017 -0.21 %; Liebergesell 2015 -0.02 %; Mannisto 2018 +0.03 %.

references: Kobe, Ravicz, et al., 1956 (critical point, NIST WebBook)
